statement: Törnberg should remain conditional because the resource surface is real but exact-baseline fairness is exposed to model drift and workflow fragility.
rationale: The paper and repo appear materially useful, but the baseline depends on a legacy GPT-4 endpoint and a less hardened reproduction stack.
keyAssumptions: The repo assets are sufficiently complete for a protocol-faithful audit.
V4 should penalize baseline time-travel risk.
validationCriteria: The released data and outputs cover the needed sample and label surfaces.
A fair audit does not require exact replay of the retired model endpoint.
critiquePoints: Notebook-centric workflows can hide implementation choices.
